top_signals.title: Volkswagen Sets Aside £725 Million for UK Motor Finance Payout
top_signals.summary: The UK financing arm of Volkswagen AG has made a £725 million ($960 million) provision to cover the costs of a plan to compensate British customers who were overcharged for car loans.

top_signals.title: Rwanda Tungsten Miner Eyes New York IPO as Munitions Metal Soars
